text: Warp core operating at 94% efficiency. Minor fluctuation in plasma conduit 7-B — within tolerances but scheduling preventive maintenance.
Crew health check complete. All 12 mission crew within normal parameters. Radiation exposure badges show baseline levels.
Arrived Kepler-442. All stop. Shields raised to level 2 as precaution — asteroid density higher than projected.
EVA Team Alpha deployed successfully. Cargo bay prepped for mineral samples — containment protocols active.
First sample batch from asteroid K442-A1-07 shows elevated concentrations of iridium and osmium.
Plasma conduit 7-B repair completed during EVA downtime — warp core efficiency back to 97%.
TRAPPIST-1 survey commencing. Water vapour signature detected in upper atmosphere — promising.
Surface scan of TRAPPIST-1e reveals potential subsurface liquid water. Thermal imaging shows hotspots near the terminator line.
Void Cartography mission underway. Entering Boötes Void perimeter. Star density dropping rapidly.
Anomalous sensor contact at long range. Raised alert status to yellow. Monitoring.
